description.en: Attaches an avatar to a character with the standard "J_07" jingle presentation and a caller-specified message — a fixed-preset wrapper around RunAttachAvatarEx (with actual attachment enabled).
Character ID to attach the avatar to.
Optional; whether to lock the avatar after attaching (defaults to true).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Attach an avatar with a specific message, as RunAttachAvatar does internally
RunAttachAvatarUseMsg(_chr, _avt, "sysmes-Avatar-00001", _lock);
